import json, subprocess, sys

def api(endpoint, **params):
    data = {"token": "***"}
    data.update({k: (str(v) if isinstance(v, bool) else v) for k, v in params.items()})
    args = ["curl", "-s", "-X", "POST", f"https://slack.com/api/{endpoint}"]
    for k, v in data.items():
        args += ["-d", f"{k}={v}"]
    out = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    d = json.loads(out)
    if not d.get("ok"):
        print("ERR", endpoint, d, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    return d

# List all (non-archived) channels public + private, paginate
channels = []
cursor = None
while True:

import json, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

def api(endpoint, **params):
    data = {"token": "***"}
    data.update({k: (str(v) if isinstance(v, bool) else v) for k, v in params.items()})
    args = ["curl", "-s", "-X", "POST", f"https://slack.com/api/{endpoint}"]
    for k, v in data.items():
        args += ["-d", f"{k}={v}"]
    out = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    d = json.loads(out)
    if not d.get("ok"):
        print("ERR", endpoint, d, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    return d

# March 2026 cutoff (UTC)
cutoff = int(datetime(2026, 3, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp())
print("cutoff (2026-03-01 UTC):", cutoff)

for cid, cname in [("C_GENERAL", "general"), ("C_PLAIN", "proj-lyra"), ("C_RANDOM", "watercooler")]:
    info = api("conversations.info", channel=cid, include_num_members="true")
    c = info["channel"]
    created = int(c["created"])
    created_dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=timezone.utc)
    members = []
    cursor = None
    while True:
        d = api("conversations.members", channel=cid, limit=1000, **({"cursor": cursor} if cursor else {}))
        members.extend(d["members"])
        cursor = d.get("response_metadata", {}).get("next_cursor")
        if not cursor:
            break
    print(f"\n{cname} ({cid}) created={created_dt.isoformat()} before_mar_2026={created < cutoff} archived={c.get('is_archived')}")
    print(f"  num_members={c.get('num_members')} actual={len(members)}")
    for m in members:
        print("   ", m, "VICTOR" if m == "U_VICTOR" else "")
